verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform docs say it calculates and files taxes automatically, handles multi-state tax requirements, and covers "all associated federal, state, and local filings and payments" through tax calculation and bank transfers. That matches the calculate, file and remit story at every jurisdiction level. One user reported a W-2c error that double-reported a quarter to the IRS; this is a single accuracy incident, not proof the capability is absent, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the tax filing and remittance mechanics (local tax coverage and deposit schedules), and independent hands-on corroboration that filings and remittances run correctly.
